7675-7676-8099.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
7675-7676-8099.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Prismatic Vista.
When Prismatic Vista enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Prismatic Vista by paying 1 life, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

277-2653-2893-7906.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Tiller Engine.
When the basic land enters, Tiller Engine, Nissa and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1849-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
1849-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

1638-2060-4217-7741.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Lutri and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Lutri from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2724-6432-7309.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Don & Leo. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

575-2482-5971.notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-2482-5971.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When the creature enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability from step 1, putting a creature card from your library into your hand.
Repeat.

997-2533-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
997-2533-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Carnage.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2438-4871-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2438-4871-5220-5243.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-7010.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3165-3532-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

969-2366-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
969-2366-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

1669-2292-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-2292-3234-3293.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
1669-2292-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4659-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

585-4508-5491-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Map and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

5078-5741-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Artist's Talent's first ability triggers. Choose not to discard a card.
Repeat

2428-3591-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2428-3591-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-5231.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding {R}.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

1978-3941-5159.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 3.
1978-3941-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Coveted Jewel that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
When Mishra's Warform enters, it triggers, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 3.

654-5414-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
654-5414-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

2034-5660-5713.description:
Cast Iron Apprentice by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Iron Apprentice, adding {C}{C}.
When Iron Apprentice dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Iron Apprentice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2068-2534-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-2534-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Coercive Recruiter and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Coercive Recruiter.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

360-1110-1981.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
360-1110-1981.description:
Cast Soul Warden by paying {W}.
When Soul Warden enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat from step 3.

719-3575-5150.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
Aerie Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
"Warrior" chosen with Xenograft.
719-3575-5150.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrifcing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Aerie Ouphes dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with no -1/-1 counter on it due to Bramblewood Paragon and Maskwood Nexus.
Repeat.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, destroying the targetted creature(s).

152-1872-4893.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

1165-2861-3090.notablePrerequisites: Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
1165-2861-3090.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, causing you to give control of Archfiend of the Dross to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

618-3396-3525.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Quirion Sentinel with haste.
Quirion Sentinel enters the battlefield, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1339-2541-2744-2836.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2541-2744-2836.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect creature token enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card, and then discard a card.
Repeat from step 2 until you draw from your empty library, winning the game instead.

687-2034-2599.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three counters on creatures you control.
687-2034-2599.description:
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters form creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ministrant of Obligation, adding {C}{C}.
Ministrant of Obligation dies, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that enter with vigilance counters on them.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Ministrant of Obligation from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from the two Spirit tokens and Ministrant of Obligation.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1335-2060-2744.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2060-2744.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

224-1257-4270.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-1257-4270.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Walking Atlas
Repeat.
